article_manifest.title: Mali: HRW confirms the execution of Malian soldiers by Jnim and the death of civilians killed by the army
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: HRW confirme l'exécution de soldats maliens par le Jnim et la mort de civils tués par l'armée
article_manifest.summary: In a new report published on Monday, October 19, the human rights organization claims that the Support Group for Islam and Muslims (Jnim) confirmed to it summary executions of Malian soldiers in Tabrichat, in the Gao region, following the attack on a military convoy from Anefis, last July The NGO Human Rights Watch (HRW) also accuses the Malian army and the Russian Africa Corps of having killed and wounded several dozen civilians during recent military operations.

article_manifest.title: Fight against crime in Konni: two suspects arrested in a case of attempted extortion of 5 million FCFA
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre la criminalité à Konni : deux suspects interpellés dans une affaire de tentative d’extorsion de 5 millions de FCFA
article_manifest.summary: Two 25-year-old Nigeriens were arrested on 15 October 2026 in Konni, in the Tahoua region, for criminal association and attempted extortion. According to the first elements of the investigation, they threatened a dealer of motorcycles and kidnapping vehicles to extract 5 million FCFA, successively using six SIM cards to blur the tracks .

article_manifest.title: Security: A generally calm and controlled situation (CICO)
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité: Une situation globalement calme et sous contrôle (CICO)
article_manifest.summary: Niamey, Oct 18 (ANP)- During the first half of October, the security situation remained generally calm and under control. Across all theatres of operations, the Defence and Security Forces have maintained their commitment and pursued their missions with determination, reports the bulletin of the Integrated Coordination Centre of Operations (CICO) . Indeed, explains the bulletin, "within Operation Shara; In Madata, near Mountseka, on October 10, 2026, the SDF neutralized an accomplice of the mercenary armed groups, wanted for his involvement in several acts of predation to the detriment of the population.

article_manifest.original_title: Image Publié le 18 octobre 2026 Afrique Niger: la pénurie d'essence s'étend à la capitale Niamey La pénurie d'essence qui touche plusieurs villes du Niger a gagné la capitale Niamey où des files d'attente s'allongent dimanche devant les stations…
article_manifest.summary: Motorcyclists queue at a gas station in Niamey, October 18, 2026 in Niger The fuel shortage affecting several Nigerian cities has reached the capital Niamey where queues lie in front of the gas stations on Sunday. Niger has been ruled since July 2023 by a military regime that advocates sovereignty, particularly over the country's mineral resources, which is notably an oil producer .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa strike two important terrorist bases in Diafarabé and Menaka
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : Les FAMa frappent deux importantes bases terroristes à Diafarabé et Ménaka
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko This Saturday, October 17, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence made it possible to locate, 40 km north-east of the city of Diafarabé, a major base housing several terrorist elements as well as war and logistics equipment.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Prayer Sessions and Sacrifices in Kati in Memory of Civilian and Military Casualties
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Séances de prières et sacrifices à Kati en mémoire des victimes civiles et militaires
article_manifest.summary: PRAYER AND SACRIFICE IN MEMORY OF CIVILIAN and MILITARY VICTIMS This Sunday, October 18, 2026, in Kati, the Minister of Religious Affairs, Worship and Customs, Dr. Mahamadou KONE, took part in a prayer and sacrifice session organized by the military hierarchy in memory of the civilian and military victims of the crisis in our country . The ceremony took place in the presence of Major General Oumar DIARRA, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, military leaders and the families of the victims, gathered for this moment of meditation, solidarity and spiritual communion .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strikes two bases housing terrorist groups in Diarafabé and Menaka
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent deux bases abritant des groupes terroristes à Diarafabé et à Ménaka
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, October 18 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, successfully carried out, on Saturday, October 17, 2026, strikes against two bases housing terrorist elements and war and logistics equipment, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, announced the General Staff of the Armed Forces . According to the press release, the exploitation of precise information made it possible to locate a large base about 40 km northeast of the city of Diafarabé.
